2.1 Portable Drilling Machine - A drilling machine with rotary air motor working as its motive power and designed to be held in operator's hand during working. 2.2 Gauge Pressure drilling machine. Steady pressure of compressed air measured within

2.3 Air Consumption - Volume of air corrected to standard atmospheric conditions of temperature and pressure according to IS : 196-l 966 `Atmospheric conditions for testing (revised)`, consumed by the drilling machine during the test. 3. Types 3.1 Based on Drilling Axis 3.1.1 Straight type - When the drilling axis is parallel to that of the air motor, the drilling shall be termed as straight type (see Fig. 1 ). These shall be designated by letter S. machine

3.1.2 Angle type - When the drilling axis is at an angle to that of the air motor, the drilling machine shall be termed as angle type. The angle may be 30", 45" or 90" ( see Fig. 2 ). Angle type shall ee designated by letter V followed by the angle, for example `V 30"`. 3.2 Based on Direction of Rotation 3.2.1 Reversible type - When the drilling machine can run in both shall be termed as reversible type and shall be designated by letter R. 3.2.2 Non-reversible type - When the ,otation when looking from the non-driving designated by letters NR. the directions of rotation it

6. General Requirements

6.1 Soeed Control - Drilling machines of nominal size 13 and above may be provided with a governor or any other device to prevent excessive speeds, air consumption and to maintain efficient speed under loads within the capacity of the drilling machine. shall be made to lubricate 6.2 lubrication - Arrangements lubricated from inline oil lubricator. 6.3 Air Inlet
Connection

bearings,

parts

not

6.3.1 Air inlet connection shall be fitted with an air strainer or screen which shall be effective in retaining solid particles in compressed air supply, The strainer or screen shall be of such design that it may be readily cleaned.

6.3.2 Air inlet connection shall have female pipe threads of the nominal sizes as given at 4, conforming to IS : 554-1975 `Dimensions for pipe threeds where pressure tight joints are required on the threads ( third revision )`.

6.7 Instruction Manual - Each tool shall be supplied with a instruction manual. Data to be provided in the instruction manual shall be in accordance with IS : 11609-I 986 `Technical supply conditions for pneumatic tools'. 7. Tests 7.1 Measurements of Air Consumption - Air consumption shall be determined with either liquid The flow measuring instrument shall displacement meter or any suitable flow measuring instrument. be located within 3 metres from the drilling machine. The air consumption reading shall be corrected to standard atmospheric conditions of temperature and pressure conforming to IS : 196-I 966. 7.2 Measurement be used.

7.3 Measurement of Pressure - For measurement of air pressure, gauges of any suitable type shall be used. The pressures to be read shall fall between one fourth and three-fourths of full scale reading. The pressure gauge shall be located within 3 meters from the drilling machine. The pressure shall remain constant at 6'0f0'5 bars during testing. 7.4 No Load Tests - No load running shall be carried out for minimum 3 minutes for the nonreversible type and for minimum 3 minutes in each forward and reverse direction for reversible type. Spead and air consumption shall be measured during no load test. The speed shall be within -5 percent and air consumption shall be within $5 percent of the declared values. 7.5 Load Test - The load test of the drilling machine shall be carried out on a suitable of suitable capacity and accurate calibration. The load shall be applied on the drilling socket of the drilling machine only after it is subjected to a preliminary running of at least Speed, torque and air consumption shall be measured during load test. The power output from speed and corresponding torque measured on the dynamometer by using the formula: p=2=n=M where

7.6 Eccentricity Test - For drilling machines fitted with chucks, the method of testing eccentricity shall be as given in IS : 2243-1971. The drilling machines fitted with Morse Taper sockets shall be tested with the test mandrel conforming to IS : 2063-1962 `Code for testing' machine tools. The maximum runout shall not exceed the limits given below:

' 7.7 Operation Test reversible types and tested for easy fitment shall be no abnormal which may have been 7.8 Endurance
Test

Each drilling machine shall be tested for easy starting and stopping for nonin each forward and reverse direction for the reversible types. It shall also be and removal of the drill point in collect, chuck or socket. During testing there noise and excessive temperature rise. The drilling machine shall show no flaws developed during testing.

7.8.1 For type approvalEach sample to disseminate energy for 100 hours in the may be done over a period) after which the No part shall either break during test or be

conforming to the specification shall be run in the test rig manufacturer's test room (100 h run need not be a stretch and tool shall be dismentled and all parts shall be examined. found broken, cracked or deformed.

7.8.2 For Routine Testing - One percent, the minimum being one, of tools on order, if the order is of 50 pieces or more, shall be run on the test rig for 15 hours run (need not be at a stretch) after which the tool shall be dismantled and all parts shall be examined. No part shall either break during testing or be found broken, cracked, deformed or how signs of excessive wear on examination. 8. Marking - The drilling machine shall be marked at a suitable place so that in the course of normal use the markings do not get damaged. The drilling machine shall be marked with manufacturer's name or trade-mark, type, nominal size, rated pressure and revolutions per minute. They shall also preferably be marked with serial number and the year of manufacture.

9. Packing - Before packing, the inlet, exhaust and other openings of each tool shall be adequately protected/covered against entry of dust and other harmful material. Packing shall be done in accordance with IS : 11609-I 986 `Technical supply condition for pneumatic tools'.
